home.heroSubtitle: HPAC Safety collects and shares incident reports so the hang gliding and paragliding community can learn from what happens in the air.

sectionWhy.title: Why report
sectionWhy.body: Every report, however small, helps identify patterns before they become serious. Reports can be filed anonymously — signing in only confirms that you are an HPAC member, and your report is never linked to your account — and are reviewed before anything is published.

sectionHow.title: How it works
sectionHow.body: You describe what happened in your own words. A reviewer checks it, and with your consent, a summary is published to help the wider community.

sectionAbout.title: About HPAC
sectionAbout.body: The Hang Gliding and Paragliding Association of Canada represents free-flight pilots across the country and promotes safe practice at every level of the sport.

questions.title: Manage questions
questions.intro: The incident form is made of these questions. Editing one creates a new version, and editing one that has already been answered replaces it with a new question, so a report already filed still shows exactly what it was asked.
questions.empty: No questions yet. Add the first one.
questions.dependsOnSummary: Only asked when “{question}” is answered yes

error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

field.privateHelp: A private question's answers help recognise identifying details and never appear in a published summary.
field.dependsOn: Only ask when another question is answered a certain way
field.dependsOnHelp: Only a yes/no or single-select question can enable another one.
field.dependsOnOptionHelp: The reporter must choose this option for the question above before this one is asked.
field.groupedUnder: Display together under a section heading
field.groupedUnderHelp: Only a group question can have other questions displayed under it.
field.optionsHelp: Adding, rewording, reordering, or removing a choice changes this question in place and never creates a new version. A removed choice disappears from the form; answers already given keep their own words.

translate.failed: The translation could not be completed. Please try again or write the other language yourself.
translate.standIn: This development server has no translation service, so Translate copies the text across unchanged. Production translates it for real.

questions.forkWarning: This question has been answered. Changing its wording, type, or settings retires it and creates a new question in its place, so the answers already given keep the wording they were given under. Editing only its choices does not.

import.title: Import from Typeform
import.intro: Upload an English export and its French export as one pair. Nothing is saved until you review and save each question yourself.

import.pendingLogicIntro: These fields had conditional logic the importer could not translate automatically. Wire up the equivalent "Depends on" setting by hand, then resolve the note.
